bio: Housed in a warehouse of this former foundry turned contemporary art center, this location blends contemporary elegance with industrial heritage. Exposed brickwork, large windows, and metal furniture create an artfully unfinished, minimalist decor. Here you can enjoy carefully prepared Italian and Mediterranean-inspired cuisine. The concise but cleverly devised menu features dishes ranging from light and fresh to warm and comforting. The crudos draw on the vibrant flavors of citrus fruit and herbs; the indulgent pastas are deeply satisfying—think caramelle with a mushroom ragout, hazelnuts, and a guinea fowl mousse. As for meat options, the venison haunch with smoked celery root and cranberry remoulade is a real house classic....
